# Third Party Libraries

# Triton Protocol Buffers

Directory `triton-common` is mainly used to generate protocol buffer generated files for Triton.

See (TRITON.md)[TRITON.md] for more information.

# TensorFlow Protocol Buffers

The Directory `go-tensorflow` contains protocol buffer generated files as expected by Go for `libtensorflow`.

See (TENSORFLOW.md)[TENSORFLOW.md] for more information.
